verdict.rationale: llama.cpp's full source is publicly hosted on GitHub. Users are told to clone the repository and build from source (gh-16), external contributors can open PRs (gh-14), and community members report compiling it from source (comm-13). The license terms themselves are never stated in the pack. missing for 10: explicit evidence naming the open-source license (e.g., a LICENSE file or license badge), independent confirmation of the licensing terms.
